{{Quote|I am Hreda, of the Drall, archivist to the Master Jedi advisor of the Republic forces!|Hreda|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Hreda''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Drall/Legends|Drall]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] Hreda joined the Corellian resistance and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces in their efforts to drive Imperials off the planet. In the [[Gilded Descent Casino/Legends|Gilded Descent Casino]] of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] Hreda worked as an archivist and advisor to the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Sumalee]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. He also met the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Voidhound]] during his search for [[Curao]].
